title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pansol Elementary School in Barrio Pansol, Municipality of Calamba, Province of Laguna, to Mababang Paaralang Don Eduardo E. Barreto
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pansol Elementary School in Barrio Pansol, Municipality of Calamba, Province of Laguna, to Mababang Paaralang Don Eduardo E. Barreto

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6160_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Pansol Elementary School in the barrio of Pansol, Municipality of Calamba, Province of Laguna, is hereby changed to Mababang Paaralang Don Eduardo E. Barreto.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
